shared_elements: horizontal rows or bands of incised/carved markings
rectangular or panel-like decorated stone surface
justification: The strongest correspondence is that both are pale stone surfaces bearing organized horizontal bands or rows of carving within a broadly panel-like area. The biggest difference is that A is dominated by many fine, weathered, text-like linear marks on a rock face, while B has large, bold relief figures and motifs arranged on a freestanding shaped stone.
